colorByProduct.description: Legacy 0.9 setting. On the first 1.0 load, true selects the Product network view; use networkView afterwards.

layerView.description: Visible and selectable underground layer: all, 1, 2, 3, or exact layer 4. Legacy value 4+ is still accepted as layer 4.

networkView.description: X-ray colouring mode: legacy (migrate colorByProduct), depth, product, or diagnostics.

showReadout.description: Show the hover read-out panel at the cursor when you point at a pipe (product, amount or percentage, and source/destination building icons). Turn off to disable the whole feature.

showBuildingIcons.description: In the hover read-out, show the icon of the building that feeds the pipe (left) and the building it feeds (right). Turn off to show only the product.

iconSize.description: Size (in pixels) of the building/product icons in the read-out and inspector. Takes effect on the next game session.

colorShallow.description: X-ray overlay colour for the shallowest buried level (hex RRGGBB). Default cyan.

colorDeep.description: X-ray overlay colour for the deepest buried level (hex RRGGBB). Levels in between are blended. Default orange.

overlayBrightness.description: Overall brightness/opacity of the whole underground x-ray overlay, in percent (0 = invisible). Lower it if the pipes look too bright. Applies to all buried pipes at once.

showInspector.description: Add a 'source -> destination' section to the game's own pipe panel (open it by clicking a pipe): it shows the real building that feeds the pipe and the one it feeds (walking through connectors/balancers), how full those tanks are, and the icons are clickable to fly the camera there.

showFlowArrows.description: Show batched animated direction arrows on buried x-ray pipes. Animation speed follows actual moved product steps; stopped networks use diagnostic colours.
